info.name: .io Search APIs Artifact Types API
Artifact Types
List openapi specifications across the catalog.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query over name and description (and tags where applicable).

params.name: providers
params.description: Comma-separated provider slugs to scope results to.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by. Tag names are Title Case (e.g. Messaging); lowercase slugs (e.g. messaging) are also accepted.

params.name: match
params.description: Whether results must match `any` (default) or `all` of the supplied tags.

params.name: include
params.description: Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page.

items.docs: First-class collection of openapi specifications across every provider on the network. Surfaces and normalizes the `OpenAPI` artifact type. Filter by free text, provider, and tags; pass `include=content` to inline each artifact body.

info.name: Every artifact a provider publishes.

params.name: slug
params.description: Provider slug (e.g. `twilio`).

items.docs: Aggregates all artifacts across a provider's APIs — grouped by type (OpenAPI, MCP, Arazzo, rules, security, pricing…) — plus per-type counts. One call instead of composing several.

info.name: One API's artifacts, grouped by type.

params.name: aid
params.description: API id in `provider:api-slug` form (e.g. `twilio:twilio-accounts-api`).

params.name: include
params.description: Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.

items.docs: Returns a single API's registered artifacts grouped by type with per-type counts. Pass `include=content` to inline the bodies.

info.name: An API's primary OpenAPI.

params.name: aid
params.description: API id in `provider:api-slug` form (e.g. `twilio:twilio-accounts-api`).

params.name: include
params.description: Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.

items.docs: Returns the primary OpenAPI reference (url) for one API — the top agent intent. Pass `include=content` to inline the spec body.
